requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: The app must handle security, encryption, audit, and compliance requirements, including data encryption, SSN storage, card number tokenization, audit logging, BSA/AML compliance, Reg E compliance, and FDIC insurance disclosure.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: The app must maintain real-time balance, update investment positions, and ensure data partitioning for system performance and scalability.

requirements.title: Card Freeze/Unfreeze Process
requirements.description: Freeze or unfreeze the physical debit card instantly from the app settings

requirements.title: Configurable Spending Limits
requirements.description: Spending limits configurable by category (ATM, online, international)

requirements.title: Merchant Category Blocking
requirements.description: Merchant category blocking (e.g., gambling, alcohol)

requirements.title: Location-Based Security
requirements.description: Location-based security - decline transactions outside home region unless traveling

requirements.title: Fee-Free ATM Access
requirements.description: Fee-free ATM access at 55,000+ Allpoint network locations

requirements.title: ATM Finder Screen
requirements.description: A screen that displays the nearest fee-free ATMs on a map.

requirements.title: Cashback Rewards
requirements.description: 1% cashback on all debit card purchases

requirements.title: Bonus Cashback Categories
requirements.description: Bonus cashback categories rotating monthly (3% on dining, gas, etc.)

requirements.title: Cashback Deposit
requirements.description: Cashback earned deposited to savings account weekly

requirements.title: Onfido KYC Integration for Digital Banking App
requirements.description: SDK integration for iOS and Android with real-time selfie liveness detection

requirements.title: Plaid Bank Account Linking for Digital Banking App
requirements.description: Plaid Link SDK integration for external bank account connection

requirements.title: Apex Clearing Brokerage Integration
requirements.description: Apex Clearing as clearing broker for brokerage integration

requirements.title: Alpaca Markets Real-time Market Data
requirements.description: Real-time market data from Alpaca Markets API

requirements.title: App Cold Launch Performance
requirements.description: App cold launch to home screen must be less than 3 seconds on iPhone 12 and equivalent Android

requirements.title: P2P Transfer Process
requirements.description: Send money to other users using phone number or email, with transfer settlement in under 1 business day

requirements.title: Investment Portfolio Screen
requirements.description: The investment portfolio screen displays the user's portfolio value, daily change, and percentage change. It features an interactive line chart and asset allocation donut chart.

requirements.title: Push Notification Delivery Performance
requirements.description: Push notification delivery latency must be less than 500ms from transaction authorization

requirements.title: Physical Debit Card Request
requirements.description: Physical debit card request with custom design and delivery tracking

requirements.title: Account Statements
requirements.description: Account statements generated monthly with PDF download and email delivery

requirements.title: Biometric Login
requirements.description: Biometric login using FaceID, TouchID, or fingerprint for all app access

requirements.title: Transaction PIN
requirements.description: Transaction PIN required for transfers over $500

requirements.title: Device Binding
requirements.description: Device binding - new device requires email verification and 24hr hold

requirements.title: Login Alerts
requirements.description: Real-time login alerts via push notification for every sign-in

requirements.title: Transaction Categorization
requirements.description: Transaction categorization (food, transport, shopping, bills, entertainment)

requirements.title: Transaction Search
requirements.description: Search transactions with filters for date, amount, category, and merchant

requirements.title: Recurring Transaction Detection
requirements.description: Recurring transaction detection with bill prediction alerts

requirements.title: Transfer Settlement
requirements.description: Transfers under $1000 settle instantly; above require 1 business day

requirements.title: Request Money
requirements.description: Request money feature with customizable message

requirements.title: Split Bill with Group
requirements.description: A 7-step workflow for users to split a bill with a group, including entering total bill amount, adding participants, and reviewing split details.

requirements.title: Transfer History
requirements.description: Transfer history with receipt sharing capability

requirements.title: Savings Goal Creation
requirements.description: Create savings goals with target amount and target date, including progress visualization and goal completion celebration animation

requirements.title: Automatic Round-Up
requirements.description: Automatic round-up of purchases to nearest dollar, deposited into savings, with configurable schedule

requirements.title: Recurring Transfers
requirements.description: Recurring automatic transfers to savings on configurable schedule, with option to edit or cancel

requirements.title: High-Yield Savings Account
requirements.description: APY displayed prominently with daily interest accrual, no minimum balance or monthly fees

requirements.title: Interest Earned Breakdown
requirements.description: Interest earned breakdown shown monthly in account statements

requirements.title: Buy Fractional Stock/ETF
requirements.description: A 6-step workflow for users to buy fractional stock or ETF, including searching for stock, selecting order type, and confirming order.

requirements.title: Dividend Tracking and Reinvestment
requirements.description: Dividend tracking and reinvestment configuration

requirements.title: Real-Time Stock Price Charts
requirements.description: Real-time stock price charts with 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, 1Y, ALL views

requirements.title: Tax Document Generation
requirements.description: Tax document generation (1099-DIV, 1099-B) for tax season

requirements.title: Crypto Trading
requirements.description: Buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and top 20 cryptocurrencies, with real-time price alerts

requirements.title: Home Dashboard Screen
requirements.description: The home screen displays total balance prominently at top center, with available and pending amounts below. It also features a horizontal scrollable row of quick action circles, recent transactions list, and bottom navigation bar.

requirements.title: Budget Tracker Monthly Spending Summary
requirements.description: Display monthly spending summary with total spent, budget remaining, and spending pace indicator

requirements.title: Card Management Screen
requirements.description: The card management screen allows users to manage their virtual debit card, including toggling controls, spending limits, and ordering a physical card.

requirements.title: Stock Purchase
requirements.description: User can buy fractional stock/ETF

requirements.title: Identity Verification
requirements.description: User completes identity verification via Onfido

requirements.title: Rewards Program Screen
requirements.description: A screen that displays cashback rewards earned and bonus cashback categories.

requirements.title: KYC Integration Screen
requirements.description: The KYC integration screen will utilize Onfido's SDK for iOS and Android, with real-time selfie liveness detection. The screen will extract name, DOB, address, and document number from the user's ID via document OCR.

requirements.title: Account Dashboard
requirements.description: Display account information, including account types, virtual debit card, and physical debit card request

requirements.title: Budget Tracker Screen
requirements.description: The budget tracker screen displays the user's monthly spending summary, category breakdown, and budget settings.

requirements.title: Invest Tab
requirements.description: A screen that displays the user's investment portfolio and allows them to buy fractional stock or ETF.

requirements.title: Cardless ATM Withdrawal Process
requirements.description: A process that allows users to withdraw cash from an ATM using a QR code.

requirements.title: P2P Instant Transfer Workflow
requirements.description: The P2P instant transfer workflow will involve the following steps: 1) biometric verification for transfer, 2) session token validation, 3) transfer service validation, 4) balance confirmation, 5) hold placement, 6) settlement confirmation, 7) debit sender, 8) credit recipient, and 9) notification service notification.

requirements.title: Digital Account Opening
requirements.description: A 8-step workflow for new users to open a digital account, including entering personal details, identity verification, selecting account type, and initial funding.

requirements.title: Send Money to Contact
requirements.description: A 7-step workflow for users to send money to contacts, including selecting recipient, entering transfer amount, and confirming transfer.
